days.file: Man geeft talenten aan zijn dienaren Gelijkenis van de talenten (serietitel), RP-P-OB-2369.jpg
days.artist: Harmen Jansz. Muller after Gerard van Groeningen
days.title: The Master Entrusts His Talents to His Servants
days.alt: A bearded master in a broad hat counts coins into his servants’ hands beside a table and an open chest.
days.look: Look again at the coins passing from the master’s hand into his servants’ hands. Which gift has God placed in your hands?

days.title: The Conversion of Saint Paul
days.license: Artist died 1682; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
days.alt: St. Paul lies thrown from his horse, one arm raised toward a light breaking through the dark sky, as a companion bends over him.
days.look: Look again at Paul on the ground, reaching up toward the light. What have you received that you never earned?

days.file: Rembrandt van Rijn - Saul and David - 621 - Mauritshuis.jpg
days.title: Saul and David
days.license: Artist died 1669; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
days.alt: Young David, in a red tunic, bends over his harp and plays with both hands.
days.look: Look again at David, lost in his playing. What might others see in you that you have not yet named?

days.file: Gelijkenis van de luie dienstknecht, RP-P-OB-46.049.jpg
days.title: The Parable of the Lazy Servant
days.license: Engraving, 1712; artist died 1712; Rijksmuseum public-domain release (Commons: CC0)
days.alt: A servant kneels before his master’s throne and sets money down on the floor while the master and his court look on.
days.look: Look again at the servant kneeling with what he kept hidden. Is there a gift you have buried out of fear?

days.title: The Angelus
days.license: Artist died 1875; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
days.alt: At dusk, a man and a woman stand in a bare field with heads bowed in prayer, a pitchfork in the ground and a loaded wheelbarrow beside them.
days.look: Look again at the tools laid down for the evening prayer. Where could a small daily rhythm of work and prayer begin for you?

days.file: La Tour - Saint Joseph charpentier, vers 1642 - 1644, RF 1948 27.jpg
days.title: Saint Joseph the Carpenter
days.license: Artist died 1652; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
days.alt: St. Joseph bends low over his work while the boy Jesus holds up a candle to light it.
days.look: Look again at Joseph bent to his work, and the Child holding the light. How can you care for your body and use it for God today?

days.file: Giotto di Bondone - No. 30 Scenes from the Life of Christ - 14. Washing of Feet - WGA09215.jpg
days.title: The Washing of the Feet
days.license: Artist died 1337; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
days.alt: Jesus kneels on the floor to wash St. Peter’s feet while the other apostles watch from their bench.
days.look: Look again at Jesus on his knees before Peter. Whom could you serve with your gift this week?

days.file: Dieric Bouts - Prophet Elijah in the Desert - WGA03015.jpg
days.title: Elijah in the Desert
days.license: Artist died 1475; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
days.alt: The prophet Elijah sleeps on the ground in his red cloak while an angel bends down and touches his shoulder.
days.look: Look again at the angel touching the sleeping prophet. What would it mean for you to rest without guilt?

days.file: La Visitation avec Marie-Jacobie et Marie-Salomé - Domenico Ghirlandaio - Musée du Louvre Peintures INV 297 ; MR 240.jpg
days.title: The Visitation
days.license: Artist died 1494; faithful photo of a 2D work (Commons: public domain)
days.alt: Mary bends toward her older cousin Elizabeth, who looks up at her as they clasp each other in greeting.
days.look: Look again at Mary and Elizabeth meeting with joy. For which gift do you most want to thank God today?
